title: Wall Mount Towel Bar 24-Inch Solid Brass Straight Bar | Mambo Collection Allied Brass
body_html:
Upgrade your bath with a 24-Inch wall mount towel bar crafted from solid brass for enduring daily use and designed to coordinate with the mambo collection.

  • Solid brass construction for long-lasting performance
  • Wall-mounted installation helps save floor space
  • Concealed screw mounting for a clean, finished appearance
  • Coordinated style for matching mambo and other designer bath accessories
  • Finish options available in a wide variety of designer finishes, including statement colors

Specs

  • Category: Towel Bars
  • Center-to-center: 24 in
  • Bar diameter: 0.5 in
  • Overall dimensions: 25 in W x 3 in H
  • Projection: 3 in
  • Weight capacity: 10 lb
  • Mounting type: Wall mount
  • Assembly required: No
  • Included: towel bar, mounting plates, and all installation hardware
  • Warranty: Limited Lifetime Warranty

Ideal for building a coordinated set of designer bathroom hardware and statement bath accessories with the distinctive look of the Mambo collection.
